title: Grateful Dead Live at Auditorium Theatre on 1971-10-21

ai_review.summary: Stellar Charlie Miller‑enhanced soundboard capture of a high‑energy 10/21/71 show featuring a smoking Dark Star > Sitting On Top Of The World > Dark Star medley and Keith Godchaux’s impressive keyboards.
ai_review.review: The October ’71 performance is praised for its relentless energy, tight set‑list flow and standout moments like the expansive Dark Star segue into Sitting on Top of the World, a fiery Truckin', and an early, peppy Tennessee Jed. The Charlie Miller‑treated SBD source delivers crystal‑clear sound with the keyboards brought forward in the mix, making this one of the best recorded shows from that tour.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average ~4.25), strong praise for both musical performance and recording quality, with multiple mentions of excellent soundboard mix and standout songs.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller upgrade yields crisp, balanced audio; keyboards are unusually prominent; no major drop‑outs or muddiness reported. Minor speaker‑placement quirks noted but not detrimental.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Sitting On Top Of The World > Dark Star
show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy first set packed with new song debuts; seamless transitions especially in the Dark Star medley, creating a tight and engaging flow throughout both sets.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers inspired, soaring guitar work with praised tone and energy, often highlighted as 'sassin' the show.'
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass is described as a terror—driving, powerful, and central to the band's interplay.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocals and rhythm guitar are noted as particularly inspired, especially during the Dark Star jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux shines on organ/piano, playing to impress with impressive fills; his keyboards sit forward in the mix thanks to the Miller treatment.
